lower arcs don't sink).\"\"\"\n    if x < -1:\n        return 0.0\n    if x < 0:\n        return smoother(x+1)\n    if x <= HITSTOP:\n        return 1.0\n    y = x-HITSTOP\n    v = math.exp(-y/4.5)*math.cos(2*math.pi*y/24*1.6)\n    return v if v > 0 else 0.25*v\n\n\nBURST = dict(spread=0.22, lift=0.07, flare=32.0)\n\n\ndef discharge_pose(p, f):\n    s = keyed(f, DIS_KEYS)\n    x = f-RELEASE\n    fade = 1.0-ramp(f, DIS_N-6, DIS_N)\n    burst = burst_env(x)*fade\n    s['h_spread'] += BURST['spread']*burst\n    s['h_lift'] += BURST['lift']*burst\n    s['h_flare'] +=     s[f'{side}_curl'] += 1.5*tt*math.sin(2.9*f+n)\n    apply(p, s)\n\n\n# -- Open Circuit\nOC_N = 30\nUNFOLD, CROWN_ACTIVE = 6, 22\n\n\ndef crown_state(**over):\n    c = dict(CROWN)\n    c.update(over)\n    return {'h_tilt': c['tilt'], 'h_lift': c['lift'], 'h_fwd': c['fwd'], 'h_spread': c['spread'], 'h_flare': c['flare']}\n\n\ndef hold_state(t):\n    tau = 2*math.pi\n    b =             spine_y=0.8*math.sin(tau*(t-0.2)), chest_y=-0.6*math.sin(tau*(t-0.25)),\n                head_y=1.2*math.sin(tau*(t-0.35)), head_z=0.8*math.sin(tau*(t-0.1))), POSES['hold'],\n             **both(curl=12+2*b-3*pulse, thumb=8-2*pulse, splay=12+4*pulse, sx=-1-1.5*b, sz=0.8*pulse))\n    for n, side in enumerate('LR'):\n        s[f'{side}_adduct'] += -3.5*b-1.2*pulse\n = len(q)\n        rng = range(m) if info['loop'] else range(m-1)\n        vel = {}\n        for i in rng:\n            d = q[i].rotation_difference(q[(i+1) % m])\n            ang = d.angle if d.angle <= math.pi else d.angle-2*math.pi\n            vel[i] = Vector(d.axis)*math.degrees(ang)\n            if abs(math.degrees(ang)) > worst_v[0]:\n                worst_v = (abs(math.degrees(ang)), n, \"\"\"Spring lag with a held pre-roll, faded to zero at both ends (neighbouring clips carry none).\"\"\"\n    def post(p, caps, frames):\n        pre = air.halo_points(p, lambda q, f: start_fn(q, math.degrees(d.angle(Vector((0, 0, -1))))\n\n\ndef pops(p, caps, frames, loop):\n    \"\"\"Angular acceleration of every bone's local rotation (deg/frame^2), wrap included for loops.\n    A pop shows as a single-frame spike; returns the worst body bones and the worst finger.\"\"\"\n    seq = frames[:-1] if loop else frames\n    n = len(seq)\n    rows = []\n    for name in p.fk:\n        par = p.bones[name].parent\n        if par is None:\n            continue\n        qs = [(caps[f][par.name].inverted() @ caps[f][name]).to_quaternion() for f in seq]\n        vel = []\n        for i in range(n if loop else n-1):\n            d = qs[i].rotation_difference(qs[(i+1) % n])\n            if d.w < 0:\n                d.negate()\n            ax, ang = d.to_axis_angle()\n            vel.append(ax*math.degrees(ang))\n        for i in range(len(vel)) if loop else range(1, len(vel)):\n            rows.append(((vel[i]-vel[i-1]).length, name, seq[i]))\n    finger = lambda nm: any(k in \"\"\"Spring lag with a held pre-roll, faded to zero at both ends (neighbouring clips carry none).\"\"\"\n    def post(p, caps, frames):\n        pre = air.halo_points(p, lambda q, f: start_fn(q, as a single-frame spike; returns the worst body bones and the worst finger.\"\"\"\n    seq = frames[:-1] if loop else frames\n    n = len(seq)\n    rows = []\n    for name in p.fk:\n        par = p.bones[name].parent\n        if par is None:\n            continue\n        qs = [(caps[f][par.name].inverted() @ caps[f][name]).to_quaternion() for f in seq]\n        vel = []\n        for i in
